description: Optional secret-ending scene. Unlock only after maxing Detective and discovering all ten clue flags.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: RECOVERED AUDIO FILE — SATURDAY, 2:14 AM

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: Hey, Mark. It's me. I know it's late. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: I just... I don't know why I'm calling. It's my birthday. Forty. I thought I'd feel different, I guess.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: Ashley wanted to see me tonight. She said we needed to talk. I knew what she wanted to talk about. I knew exactly what she wanted to talk about.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: I couldn't do it. I couldn't sit there and listen to someone else tell me that I'm not enough.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: I keep telling myself that once I finish the next project, once I get through the next deadline, then I'll have time. Time for her. Time for Mom. Time for everyone.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: But there's always something else. There's always another problem to fix. And I don't know what to do when there isn't one.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: I don't think I know how to do anything else anymore. I just wanted everything to stop for a little while.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: I'll call you tomorrow. Sorry, man.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: The recording ends.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: ...So that's it? There was no conspiracy. No sabotage. No hidden enemy. Just you.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: We built something impressive. We spent years refining it. But somewhere along the way, we stopped maintaining the foundation.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: ...Well. That's depressing.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: You spent so long trying to understand everything around you that you stopped trying to understand yourself.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: You were stressed. You were lonely. You were unhappy. And instead of telling anyone, you tried to bury it.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: We weren't supposed to be three separate voices. We were all parts of the same person.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: The part that wanted to take shortcuts. The part that wanted to pretend everything was fine. The part that wanted to figure out what went wrong.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: And the part that never stopped trying to fix things.

lines.speaker: Bjarne
lines.text: ...I did this to myself.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: You made mistakes. That doesn't mean you're beyond repair.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: And for the record, drinking until you delete your own operating system is a terrible recovery strategy.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: You can't undo what happened that weekend. But perhaps you can decide what happens next.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: SEGMENTATION FAULT OF THE SOUL

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: You cannot debug a life you refuse to live.
